description: Store information in SAIHM persistent memory. Encryption happens in this process and the key never leaves it, so the server holds ciphertext it cannot read. Use this when a fact, decision, or piece of context should outlive the current session. Pass an existing cellId to update that cell instead of adding a new one; when the endpoint reports that the update left shares of the cell on the previous version, they are re-issued for the new version and the result counts them, and a share that was not re-issued needs saihm_share again. Returns the cell id that saihm_forget takes. With warmStart "put", it instead stores an encrypted warm-start snapshot of the payload file named by token.

cellId.description: Existing cell id (hex) to update; omit to create a new cell

content.description: Information to remember. Required unless warmStart is "put".

coversThrough.description: With warmStart "put": the change feed position the payload covers, the cursor of a position marker. Blank otherwise.

token.description: With warmStart: 16 to 32 characters from a-z and 0-9, chosen at random for this call. It names the payload file. Blank otherwise.

warmStart.description: "put" stores the payload file warm-start/put-<token>.bin as an encrypted snapshot, then removes the file. Only coversThrough and token go with it. Leave it blank to remember content.

name: saihm_remember

commitmentHash.description: Deprecated: the same value as commitment, kept for existing readers.
